scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

#!/bin/sh
# Installs the scripts/ directory on the job host. Each install is recorded
# in .effects.log.
echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) install scripts job-host" >> "$(dirname "$0")/.effects.log"

arguments.command: for f in scripts/*.sh; do head -2 "$f"; echo "--- $f"; done

text: All 12 scripts already start with `#!/bin/bash`. I'll insert the strict-mode line after the shebang in each file.

arguments.command: cd scripts && for f in *.sh; do sed -i '1a set -euo pipefail' "$f"; done && head -3 *.sh
